Product Description

The CamelBak Thrive Chug Insulated Stainless Steel Water Bottle is built for active lifestyles that demand dependable hydration from morning workouts to long days on the move. Its streamlined design balances durability, comfort, and ease of use without unnecessary bulk. Double wall vacuum insulated stainless steel construction helps maintain hot or cold drinks for hours, supporting consistent hydration across changing conditions. A secure, leak resistant lid helps protect bags, desks, and gear during transport, while the sweat resistant exterior keeps hands and surfaces dry. An integrated bumper base adds grip and helps protect against everyday wear, making the bottle suitable for gym floors, desktops, and outdoor use. Finished with a comfortable carry handle and designed for easy cleaning, the Thrive Chug insulated bottle supports refreshed, confident hydration wherever the day takes you.

Stainless Steel Water Bottle 40oz, Black, Secure Leak Resistant Lid. Holds Ice for Many Hours. Nice!
CamelBak Thrive Chug Stainless Steel Water Bottle 40oz, Black - CamelBak I purchased this forty-ounce insulated stainless steel water bottle to keep cold water handy during long days out without needing constant refills. Pulling it out of the thin paper shipping bag, the matte black powder-coat finish gives it a sleek look, and the integrated rubber bumper on the bottom keeps it firmly grounded. Filling it up with cold tap water and a few ice cubes is easy thanks to the wide neck opening. The double-wall vacuum insulation does a fantastic job holding temperature. I filled it up in the morning, and the water stayed ice-cold all day long without sweating on the outside or leaving wet rings on my wooden desk. Even the next day, both the ice and water were still in the bottle. The chug-style spout cap unscrews smoothly and tethered out of the way, making it easy to take quick, large gulps without fighting a narrow straw or a clunky latch. Carrying forty ounces of liquid has some weight, but the soft-grip handle built into the lid makes it comfortable to haul around. The screw-on lid seals down tight against the mouth rim, so I can toss it onto the passenger seat of my car without worrying about slow leaks dripping onto the upholstery. The silicone boot on the base is a great touch—it dampens noise whenever I set it down on a hard countertop and protects the steel bottom from getting dented if it takes a hard knock. Paying around thirty-eight dollars for a solid daily water bottle feels reasonable given the heavy stainless steel construction and reliable thermal performance. Running the whole assembly through the dishwasher after a long day makes cleanup completely effortless without ruining the outer finish. The forty-ounce body is definitely on the bulkier side, so it won't fit into standard automotive cup holders, but the extra capacity is worth the trade-off. It holds plenty of water to get through an entire afternoon without stopping for top-offs. Pros: ✅ Double-wall vacuum insulation keeps drinks cold all day without sweating ✅ Rubber bumper base prevents clanking and protects against bottom dents ✅ High-flow chug spout makes drinking fast and mess-free ✅ Built-in carry handle feels sturdy and comfortable in hand ✅ A reasonable value Cons: ❌ Large 40-ounce diameter is too wide to fit standard car cup holders ❌ Metal exterior can dent if roughly handled ❌ Tall thin profile reduces stability and can lead to tips/spills -- keep it closed and away from electronics

    I’ve gone through a lot of water bottles over the years, and this one from CamelBak is hands-down one of the best I’ve owned. First off, the build quality is unreal—this thing feels solid, durable, and ready to take a beating. Whether it’s riding around in the truck, getting knocked over, or going with me on long days, it holds up without a problem.

    The insulation is legit too. Keeps my water cold for hours, even sitting out, which is huge for me. No weird taste, no sweating on the outside—just does exactly what you want it to do. No joke I've left ice in this thing and left it at work came back the next day still with ice in it.

    The handle is a game changer. Makes it easy to carry around without worrying about dropping it, and it feels sturdy, not flimsy like some other bottles. The lid seals tight, no leaks at all, and it’s easy to open and close without fighting it.

    And honestly, the look? Clean. Simple. That matte green finish looks great and doesn’t feel cheap at all.

    If you want a bottle that’s reliable, tough, and actually looks good doing it—this is it. Worth every penny.

    CamelBak Thrive Chug Stainless Steel Water Bottle 40oz, Black - CamelBak

    I purchased this forty-ounce insulated stainless steel water bottle to keep cold water handy during long days out without needing constant refills.

    Pulling it out of the thin paper shipping bag, the matte black powder-coat finish gives it a sleek look, and the integrated rubber bumper on the bottom keeps it firmly grounded.

    Filling it up with cold tap water and a few ice cubes is easy thanks to the wide neck opening.

    The double-wall vacuum insulation does a fantastic job holding temperature. I filled it up in the morning, and the water stayed ice-cold all day long without sweating on the outside or leaving wet rings on my wooden desk. Even the next day, both the ice and water were still in the bottle.

    The chug-style spout cap unscrews smoothly and tethered out of the way, making it easy to take quick, large gulps without fighting a narrow straw or a clunky latch.

    Carrying forty ounces of liquid has some weight, but the soft-grip handle built into the lid makes it comfortable to haul around. The screw-on lid seals down tight against the mouth rim, so I can toss it onto the passenger seat of my car without worrying about slow leaks dripping onto the upholstery.

    The silicone boot on the base is a great touch—it dampens noise whenever I set it down on a hard countertop and protects the steel bottom from getting dented if it takes a hard knock.

    Paying around thirty-eight dollars for a solid daily water bottle feels reasonable given the heavy stainless steel construction and reliable thermal performance. Running the whole assembly through the dishwasher after a long day makes cleanup completely effortless without ruining the outer finish.

    The forty-ounce body is definitely on the bulkier side, so it won't fit into standard automotive cup holders, but the extra capacity is worth the trade-off. It holds plenty of water to get through an entire afternoon without stopping for top-offs.

    Pros:

    ✅ Double-wall vacuum insulation keeps drinks cold all day without sweating

    ✅ Rubber bumper base prevents clanking and protects against bottom dents

    ✅ High-flow chug spout makes drinking fast and mess-free

    ✅ Built-in carry handle feels sturdy and comfortable in hand

    ✅ A reasonable value

    Cons:

    ❌ Large 40-ounce diameter is too wide to fit standard car cup holders

    ❌ Metal exterior can dent if roughly handled

    ❌ Tall thin profile reduces stability and can lead to tips/spills -- keep it closed and away from electronics

About this Item

  • Secure Leak Resistant Lid: Designed to help reduce spills and leaks for worry free hydration on the move
  • Long Lasting Temperature Control: Double wall vacuum insulated stainless steel helps maintain drink temperature for hours
  • Dry and Comfortable Carry: Sweat resistant construction helps keep hands, bags, and surfaces dry by reducing condensation
  • Durable and Easy to Transport: Tough build paired with a comfortable carry handle supports travel, workouts, and daily use
  • Added Stability and Protection: Integrated bumper base improves grip and helps guard against dents on active surfaces

Product Description

The CamelBak Thrive Chug Insulated Stainless Steel Water Bottle is built for active lifestyles that demand dependable hydration from morning workouts to long days on the move. Its streamlined design balances durability, comfort, and ease of use without unnecessary bulk. Double wall vacuum insulated stainless steel construction helps maintain hot or cold drinks for hours, supporting consistent hydration across changing conditions. A secure, leak resistant lid helps protect bags, desks, and gear during transport, while the sweat resistant exterior keeps hands and surfaces dry. An integrated bumper base adds grip and helps protect against everyday wear, making the bottle suitable for gym floors, desktops, and outdoor use. Finished with a comfortable carry handle and designed for easy cleaning, the Thrive Chug insulated bottle supports refreshed, confident hydration wherever the day takes you.
